info.name: Bhukkad Platform E2E — Full API & Edge-Case Suite
info.description: Exhaustive API coverage for the Bhukkad microservices platform through the API gateway: every reachable endpoint plus edge cases (validation, auth, cross-tenant, role escalation, injection, not-found). Import into Postman (Import → File) or run headlessly: npx newman run bhukkad-e2e-postman-collection.json. Requires the local docker-compose stack (gateway on :8095).

item.name: 0-Warmup
item.description: Services run with lazy-initialization; these one-shot requests pay the per-route warmup cost before asserting folders run. No strict assertions — a transient 503 during a redeploy window must not fail the suite.

item.name: 00-Setup
item.description: Seeds unique-per-run fixtures (users, restaurant, menu) and stores tokens/ids as collection variables.
